// Package addrderef: &x of a pointer-passed x is written x, never &(*x) (★).
package addrderef

func use(p *int) { *p += 5 }

// F shares x with a closure, so x goes by pointer.
func F() int {
	x := 1
	get := func() int { return x }
	bump(&x)
	return get()
}

// bump is part of F, extracted by my_editor.
func bump(x *int) {
	use(x)
	(*x)++
}
